authority: Illinois Department of Natural Resources and Illinois General Assembly

contradictions.subject: official-pdf-label-versus-content
contradictions.priorState: The Illinois DNR path named 17-1100.pdf appeared to offer an official portable copy of the exotic weeds rule.
contradictions.currentEvidence: The file served on August 1, 2026 contained unrelated 17 IAC Part 720 turkey rules rather than Part 1100.
contradictions.resolution: The mislabeled PDF was not retained or used. The current Illinois General Assembly Part 1100 authority page and exact Section 1100.30 HTML are the operative sources.

contradictions.subject: future-effective-callery-pear
contradictions.priorState: Callery pear appears in the official list table.
contradictions.currentEvidence: The same rule states that Callery pear is included only starting January 1, 2028.
contradictions.resolution: The row is preserved as blocked future context and creates no current applicability decision.

contradictions.subject: source-taxonomy
contradictions.priorState: The list contains genus, hybrid, synonym, source-spelling, and unmatched taxon text.
contradictions.currentEvidence: Ten currently effective rows do not pass the exact current catalog-binomial gate.
contradictions.resolution: All ten remain blocked for explicit taxonomy review. Unusable or unmatched rows create no not-applicability, occurrence, absence, or not-detected evidence.

contradictions.subject: local-powershell-probe-failure
contradictions.priorState: The first stability probe attempted to use Invoke-WebRequest and RawContentStream without writing an artifact.
contradictions.currentEvidence: The Windows PowerShell cmdlet failed locally with a null-reference error before a valid provider response was recorded.
contradictions.resolution: The failed local attempt is not counted as a provider request. Three independent .NET byte probes and the deterministic builder capture all returned the same 18054-byte hash.
